quest.title: A Warning From the Wrathful Fish!
quest.description: Sigewinne seems to have something to tell us...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, I have some wonderful news. Everything's finally in place!

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Operation Aggro-Fish De-Escalation has been a huge success!

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Once the divers have cleared away all the underwater debris and our patients are a bit more relaxed, we'll be able to return them back to the wild.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks so much for all your hard work.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, you've been working just as hard as us, Sigewinne.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: I've written an incident report and submitted it to the Palais Mermonia. A specialist in this field should be drafting relevant regulations and will notify the appropriate agencies soon...

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: I've also heard that some reporters, and at least one director, have shown great interest in this matter.

dialogues.speaker: Sigewinne
dialogues.text: Who knows, maybe we'll even get to see a film about the importance of protecting aquatic environments one day?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That would be awesome! You can talk to people all you want, but there'll always be careless or stubborn folks who simply won't listen.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They need to see something really scary... Make them think that if the environment gets completely ruined, the fish will... mutate into giant, invincible monsters and destroy everything!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Give everyone who throws junk in the sea the scariest, most terrifying nightmares. That'll teach 'em to respect nature!
